Name: juminos' Trinkets (Trinket Tinker content)
Author: juminos
Description:
New trinkets that summon helpful companions like junimos, slimes, and dust sprites. Content pack for mushymato's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29073]Trinket Tinker[/url] framework.

[b]Junimo Star[/b]: Summons a junimo companion that harvests forage and crops. Available in a variety of colors and 4 levels.
[list]
[*]Level 1: harvests nearby forage
[*]Level 2: harvests nearby forage and crops
[*]Level 3: harvests crops and double forage
[*]Level 4: harvests double crops and double forage
[/list][b]Jar O' Slime[/b]: Summons a slime companion that helps fight monsters. Available in a variety of colors and 3 levels.
[list]
[*]Level 1: When you take damage, attacks the nearest monster for 15-30 damage, stunning them for 3 seconds
[*]Level 2: When you take damage, attacks the nearest monster for 30-45 damage, stunning them for 3 seconds
[*]Level 3: When you take damage, attacks the nearest monster for 35-50 damage, stunning them for 4 seconds
[*]Level 4: When you take damage, attacks the nearest monster for 50-65 damage, stunning them for 4 seconds
[*]Level 5: When you take damage, attacks the nearest monster twice for 50-65 damage, stunning them for 4 seconds

[/list][b]Spirit Coal[/b]: Summons dust sprites that break coal out of rocks and drop coffee or triple shot espresso. Available in 3 levels.[list]
[*]Level 1: frees coal from nearby rocks and rarely drops coffee
[*]Level 2: frees coal from nearby rocks, occasionally drops coffee or rarely triple shot espresso
[*]Level 3: frees coal from nearby rocks, occasionally drops coffee or triple shot espresso
[/list]
How to obtain:
[spoiler]These trinkets will drop randomly in the game in the same ways the vanilla trinkets do, but they will always be level 1 and the first color variant. To obtain other levels/colors, you can randomly get them from cracking open Artifact Troves. Also, the Trinket Tinker mod adds a recolor device that allows you to reroll these trinkets, similar to the game's anvil.[/spoiler]

Config Options
Junimo Crop Harvest Range: sets distance from player that junimo companion will travel to harvest crops (0-10).
Junimo Ignores Flowers: whether junimo companions that can harvest crops will leave flowers alone (if after turning off this option the junimo won't harvest flowers, restarting the game should fix it)
